mapper.select: SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_title_name , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name FROM emp01_person WHERE 1=1 AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp01_person_id IN #{personId} ORDER BY emp01_emp_no
